Messages.Body:
I'm not sure:

1)I play a Raven Spy on Raven (inf. Animalism => Raven Spy with 1 life)
and after that I play Animalism Master Discipline: does the Raven gain
1 additional life (as stated for sup. Animalism)?

2)Wynn uses his special ability to enter combat with Arika and no-one
blocks him (NOT EVEN Arika): can she use Obedience to stop the combat,
or does she need to block Wynn?

Thanx.

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.

Messages.Author: Tim Eijpe
Messages.Body:
In article <8s6qv6$bp3$1...@nnrp1.deja.com>,

francoi...@my-deja.com wrote:
> I'm not sure:
>
> 1)I play a Raven Spy on Raven (inf. Animalism => Raven Spy with 1
life)
> and after that I play Animalism Master Discipline: does the Raven gain
> 1 additional life (as stated for sup. Animalism)?

No. Retainers keep the life they have when being recruited, even if the
recruiting vampire enchances its skill in a discipline, or if the
retainer is moved to another vampire who has the superior version of the
required discipline, via Heidelberg or Shepard's Innocence etc.

>
> 2)Wynn uses his special ability to enter combat with Arika and no-one
> blocks him (NOT EVEN Arika): can she use Obedience to stop the combat,
> or does she need to block Wynn?

According to another thread this would be the case, though I am too a
bit puzzled over this. Can't wait to read the official answer to this
one.

Tim Eijpe

Thanx.

Sure

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
francoi...@my-deja.com wrote:
>
> I'm not sure:
>
> 1)I play a Raven Spy on Raven (inf. Animalism => Raven Spy with 1 life)
> and after that I play Animalism Master Discipline: does the Raven gain
> 1 additional life (as stated for sup. Animalism)?

* A discipline-based card that is put into play is put into play at
either basic or superior level. Once in play, you can't change which
level it was played at, even if you give the vampire that played it a
better ability. [TOM 03-APR-1996]

> 2)Wynn uses his special ability to enter combat with Arika and no-one
> blocks him (NOT EVEN Arika): can she use Obedience to stop the combat,
> or does she need to block Wynn?

She can use Obedience. Obedience does not require a block.
